title: celebrity assistant
content: have any of you guys had the “celebrity assistant” mallworld dream? it def stems from being a wattpad reader, so hear me out if that was you. it starts off in the school. usually i get out of class, then get pulled to the side. “you have a job.” cool, what is it? “there’s a concert tonight and __’s personal assistant is out sick. can you cover?” “sure, i don’t have anything going on.” usually i meet the artist, and then the inconveniences slowly start. i get stuck in foot traffic. nobody’s moving fast enough. the store im in gets robbed while im trying to get their snacks. for some reason i have to go to the theatre and steal costumes. go to the thrift for random shirts to see if any match their style. i’m always stressing because they’re way too big. dresses are always way too big and way too ugly. when it comes to the actual concert, nobody shows up. any childs first birthday party is more populated than this concert. you literally have to pep talk them during sound check. everything keeps malfunctioning. lights, soundboard, pyro, everything. eventually, you get to walk home in the worst weather ever!!! 🥰😸 this is my 6th time having this dream in mallworld and it’s starting to piss me off LOL. anyone else experiencing this? need someone to validate me here omg
